{{Infobox auto}}

'''Dough''' is an [[ingredient]] made from [[flour]] and the base of breads, pastries and pasta. It can't be eaten. Baked in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] it becomes [[bread]], and fired in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] it becomes [[naan]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
An [[egg]] and 2 flour make 4 dough. A [[water bottle]] and 1 flour make 1 dough; the water recipe accepts any potion.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/dough.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/dough_from_water.json}}</ref> The glass bottle is meant to be given back, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that returns it still names the recipe by an old ID, so it is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

Picking up dough unlocks [[bread]], [[naan]], [[seitan]] and slime balls (dough and lime dye make 2). Dough is the base of the empanadas, [[Pizza|pizzas]], [[stroganoff]], cupcakes, [[brownie]]s, [[Chocolate Chip Cookie|chocolate chip cookie]]s, [[Buñuelo|buñuelos]], [[puerquito]]s, [[pupusa]]s, [[lumpia]], [[Pad Thai]], [[Chorus Mochi|chorus mochi]], [[Ramen Stock|ramen stock]] and more.
